scanNote:
4-UNITNING IKKINCHI BETI (27-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Days to Remember' va TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '4'.

CHAP USTUNDA och pushti-krem fonli HIKOYA (yirtilgan qog'oz shaklida):
Sarlavha qo'lyozma uslubidagi to'q sariq harflarda: 'The Wedding Anniversary'.
Matn ichida to'rtta raqamlangan KATAKChA (1, 2, 3, 4) - 26-betdagi 4-mashqning bo'shliqlari; skanda ularga QO'LDA harflar yozilgan (1-C, 2-A, 3-D, 4-B).
Qalin harfli so'zlar: alone, heavily, blowing, sweetly, replied, local taxi service, collect, puzzled, lap, ghost, softly, wedding anniversary.
Matn pastida OQ ATIRGULLAR surati.

5) 'Read the story again and correct the statements.' To'rtta gap; 1-gapda ko'k qiya javob berilgan (namuna). 2, 3, 4-gaplar yoniga QO'LDA to'g'ri so'zlar yozilgan (long, bouquet, sitting).

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Language Development' sarlavhasi.
6) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: anniversary, taxi, change, ticking, sounds, bouquet, gasp, front, wedding. Ikki ustunda 9 nuqtali qator.
7) 'Underline the correct word in bold.' Beshta gap, har birida qalin harfli ikki variant.
8) 'Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Yetti ibora bir xatboshida.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Use words/phrases from the list, and the pictures on p. 26, to help you retell the story.' Uzun qiya harfli so'zlar ro'yxati.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Adjectives - Adverbs' sarlavhasi.
• Och ko'k-yashil ramkali 'Use' qutisi: 'Adjectives describe nouns. Adverbs usually describe verbs or other adverbs.' Ostida to'q sariq qiya misollar.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '27'.

exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaNING TO'LIQ MATNI VA TARJIMASI
bandlarda berilgan (bo'shliqlar
to'ldirilgan holda).


⚠ HIKOYaNING SIRI:

  Eshik oldiga kelgan yosh ayol -
  Jeymsning BUVISI, 1910-yil 15-aprelda
  turmushga chiqqan.
  U o'sha kuni - TO'Y YILLIGIda -
  qaytib kelgan.

  ⚠ Ya'ni bu ARVOH haqidagi hikoya
  (26-betdagi 2-mashqning javobi).


⚠ SO'NGGI GAP - KALIT:

  "Well, that's her in the photograph -
   and today is 15th April. It's her
   WEDDING ANNIVERSARY."

  ⚠ 'an anniversary' = yillik.
  ⚠ 'a wedding anniversary' = to'y
  yilligi.


⚠ MATNDAGI ZAMONLAR - 4-UNIT
GRAMMATIKASI:

  PAST CONTINUOUS (uzun, fon):
     'Janice WAS ALONE ... WAITING for
      her husband'
     'It WAS RAINING heavily'
     'the wind WAS BLOWING'
     'She WAS WATCHING TV'
     'she WAS WEARING a long white dress'
     'her flowers WERE LYING on the
      doormat'
     'she WAS STILL SITTING on the stairs'
     'It WAS TICKING loudly'

  PAST SIMPLE (qisqa, bir martalik):
     'the doorbell RANG'
     'she OPENED the door'
     'the young woman SAID'
     'Janice REPLIED'
     'She WENT to the telephone'
     'She SAT DOWN on the stairs'
     'James LAUGHED'
     'he HEARD the sound'
     'He WENT into the room and TURNED
      ON the light'

  ⚠ Qoida: uzun ish - CONTINUOUS,
  uni bo'lgan qisqa ish - SIMPLE.


⚠ QALIN HARFLI SO'ZLAR:

  alone       = yolg'iz
  heavily     = qattiq (yomg'ir haqida)
  to blow     = esmoq (shamol)
  sweetly     = shirin ohangda
  to reply    = javob bermoq
  a taxi service = taksi xizmati
  to collect  = borib olmoq
  puzzled     = hayron, tushunmayotgan
  a lap       = tizza usti
  a ghost     = arvoh
  softly      = sekin, ohista
  a wedding anniversary = to'y yilligi

points.en: It was half past ten at night and Janice was alone in the house, waiting for her husband to come home.
points.uz: Kechasi o'n yarim edi va Janice uyda yolg'iz, erining uyga qaytishini kutib o'tirardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'half past ten' = 10:30.
⚠ 'AT night' - ISTISNO ('in the night' emas).
⚠ 'to wait FOR sb' - predlog 'for' (8-mashqda).
⚠ 'alone' = yolg'iz (7-mashqda).

points.en: It was raining heavily outside and the wind was blowing.
points.uz: Tashqarida qattiq yomg'ir yog'ardi va shamol esardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS - hikoyaning FONI.
⚠ 'heavily' = qattiq (yomg'ir haqida);
'strongly' EMAS.
⚠ 'to blow' = esmoq (blow - blew - blown).

points.en: She was watching TV when the doorbell rang. "James has lost his keys again," she thought as she opened the door.
points.uz: U televizor ko'rayotganda eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringladi. "Jeyms yana kalitlarini yo'qotibdi", - deb o'yladi u eshikni ocharkan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'was watching' (uzun) + 'rang' (qisqa) -
4-unit grammatikasining ASOSIY qolipi.
⚠ 'to ring' - noto'g'ri fe'l: ring - rang - rung.
⚠ 'as' bu yerda = ... arkan, ... paytda.

points.en: [1 = C] Instead of her husband, though, Janice saw a young woman standing there. She was wearing a long white dress under her coat, and she was holding a bouquet of pretty flowers.
points.uz: [1 = C] Ammo eri o'rniga Janice u yerda turgan yosh ayolni ko'rdi. U paltosi ostidan uzun oq ko'ylak kiygan va chiroyli guldasta ushlab turardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 4-mashqning 1-javobi.
⚠ 'instead of' = ... o'rniga.
⚠ 'saw sb STANDING' - -ING shakli jarayonni
bildiradi.
⚠ 'a bouquet' - 6-betdagi 4-mashqda ham bor edi.

points.en: "Excuse me," the young woman said sweetly. "Would it be all right if I used your phone to call for a taxi?"
points.uz: "Kechirasiz", - dedi yosh ayol shirin ohangda. "Telefoningizdan taksi chaqirsam bo'ladimi?"
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'sweetly' - RAVISh ('sweet' + -ly).
⚠ 'Would it be all right if I used ...?' -
juda MULOYIM iltimos (past simple ishlatiladi).
⚠ 'to call FOR a taxi' - predlog 'for'
(8-mashqda).

points.en: "Oh, yes, of course," Janice replied. "I'll call one for you now."
points.uz: "Ha, albatta", - javob berdi Janice. "Hozir sizga chaqiraman".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to reply' = javob bermoq ('to reply TO sb').
⚠ "I'll" - shu daqiqada qabul qilingan qaror.
⚠ 'one' = 'a taxi' (takrorlamaslik uchun).

points.en: She went to the telephone, asked the local taxi service to collect the young woman, and returned to the front door.
points.uz: U telefonga bordi, mahalliy taksi xizmatidan yosh ayolni olib ketishni so'radi va oldingi eshikka qaytdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to ask sb TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.
⚠ 'to collect sb' = borib olmoq.
⚠ 'the front door' = ko'chaga chiqadigan eshik
(6-mashqda).

points.en: The young woman wasn't there, but her flowers were lying on the doormat.
points.uz: Yosh ayol u yerda yo'q edi, lekin gullari poyandozda yotardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'were lying' - PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'lying' - 'lie' fe'lidan ('lieing' XATO).
⚠ 7-mashqda 'laying/lying' ataylab qarshi
qo'yilgan.

points.en: [2 = A] Janice couldn't see her anywhere, so she picked up the flowers, went inside and phoned the taxi service again to cancel the call.
points.uz: [2 = A] Janice uni hech qayerda ko'rmadi, shuning uchun gullarni oldi, ichkariga kirdi va chaqiruvni bekor qilish uchun taksi xizmatiga yana qo'ng'iroq qildi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 4-mashqning 2-javobi.
⚠ 'anywhere' - INKOR gapda 'hech qayerda'.
⚠ 'to cancel' - Britaniyada 'cancelLED'
(7-mashqda).

points.en: She sat down on the stairs, puzzled by the young woman's mysterious disappearance.
points.uz: U yosh ayolning sirli g'oyib bo'lishidan hayron bo'lib zinapoyaga o'tirdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'puzzled' = hayron, tushunmayotgan.
⚠ 'to sit ON the stairs' - predlog 'on'
(8-mashqda).
⚠ 'a disappearance' = g'oyib bo'lish
('to disappear' fe'lidan).

points.en: There was something familiar about the woman, but Janice couldn't think what it was.
points.uz: Ayolda tanish nimadir bor edi, lekin Janice u nima ekanini o'ylab topolmadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'familiar' = tanish (7-mashqda).
⚠ 'something familiar' - SIFAT 'something' dan
KEYIN turadi.
⚠ 'what it was' - o'zlashtirma so'roq: so'z
tartibi ODDIY.

points.en: When James got home half an hour later, she was still sitting on the stairs with the flowers on her lap.
points.uz: Yarim soatdan keyin Jeyms uyga kelganda, u hamon zinapoyada gullar tizzasida o'tirardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'got home' (qisqa) + 'was sitting' (uzun) -
yana 4-unit qolipi.
⚠ 'half an hour' - 'AN hour' ('h' o'qilmaydi).
⚠ 'a lap' = tizza usti.

points.en: "What's the matter?" he asked. "You look as if you've seen a ghost."
points.uz: "Nima bo'ldi?" - so'radi u. "Arvoh ko'rganga o'xshaysan".
points.noteUz:
⚠ "What's the matter?" = nima bo'ldi?
⚠ 'You look AS IF ...' = ... ga o'xshaysan.
⚠ 'to see a ghost' - shu ibora hikoyaning
MAVZUSIGA ishora qiladi.

points.en: "Perhaps I have," she said jokingly. She showed James the flowers, and told him about the strange woman.
points.uz: "Balki ko'rgandirman", - dedi u hazillashib. U Jeymsga gullarni ko'rsatdi va g'alati ayol haqida aytib berdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Perhaps I have' = 'Perhaps I have seen a
ghost' - takroriy qism TUShIRIB QOLDIRILGAN.
⚠ 'jokingly' - RAVISh ('a joke' so'zidan).
⚠ 'to tell sb ABOUT sth' - predlog 'about'
(8-mashqda).

points.en: James laughed, then went upstairs to change his clothes.
points.uz: Jeyms kuldi, keyin kiyimini almashtirish uchun yuqoriga chiqdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to change one's clothes' = kiyim almashtirmoq
(6-mashqda).
⚠ 'upstairs' - PREDLOGSIZ ravish.
⚠ MAQSAD uchun INFINITIV: 'TO change'.

points.en: As he was going past the guest room, he heard the sound of a clock ticking.
points.uz: Mehmonxona yonidan o'tayotganda soatning chiqillashini eshitdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'As he WAS GOING' (uzun) + 'he HEARD' (qisqa).
⚠ 'past' bu yerda PREDLOG: 'yonidan o'tib'
(9-betdagi xatda ham bor edi).
⚠ 'a clock ticking' = chiqillayotgan soat
(6-mashqda).

points.en: "It sounds like the clock my grandparents had when I was a child," James thought, "but that stopped working twenty years ago."
points.uz: "Bu bolaligimda buvim-bobomda bo'lgan soatga o'xshaydi", - deb o'yladi Jeyms, "lekin u yigirma yil oldin ishlamay qolgan".
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'It sounds like ...' = ... ga o'xshaydi
(6-mashqda).
⚠ 'to stop DOING sth' = qilishni to'xtatmoq;
'to stop TO DO sth' - butunlay boshqa ma'no!
⚠ 'ago' - gap oxirida.

points.en: He went into the room and turned on the light. His grandparents were no longer alive, but many of their things were still there.
points.uz: U xonaga kirdi va chiroqni yoqdi. Buvi-bobosi endi tirik emas edi, lekin ularning ko'p narsalari hamon u yerda edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to turn ON the light' = chiroq yoqmoq
(8-mashqda). Aksi: 'to turn off'.
⚠ 'no longer' = endi ... emas.
⚠ 'alive' - SIFAT, otdan OLDIN turmaydi
('an alive man' XATO; 'a living man').

points.en: James looked around and saw his grandparents' clock. It was ticking loudly and it showed the correct time.
points.uz: Jeyms atrofga qaradi va buvi-bobosining soatini ko'rdi. U qattiq chiqillayotgan va to'g'ri vaqtni ko'rsatardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ "grandparents'" - KO'PLIKDA egalik:
apostrof -S dan KEYIN.
⚠ 'the correct time' - 7-mashqda 'time/hour'
qarshi qo'yilgan.
⚠ 'loudly' - RAVISh.

points.en: [3 = D] Then James noticed an old photograph next to the clock. It was a picture of a young couple on their wedding day, with "15th April, 1910" written on the photograph.
points.uz: [3 = D] Keyin Jeyms soat yonidagi eski suratni payqab qoldi. Bu to'y kunidagi yosh juftlikning surati edi, unda "1910-yil 15-aprel" deb yozilgan edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 4-mashqning 3-javobi.
⚠ 'ON sb's wedding day' - predlog 'on'
(8-mashqda).
⚠ '15th April, 1910' - Britaniya sanasi:
kun → oy → yil.

points.en: James took the picture and went downstairs. "I know who the young woman was," he said softly, showing Janice the photograph.
points.uz: Jeyms suratni oldi va pastga tushdi. "Yosh ayol kim ekanini bilaman", - dedi u ohista, Janice'ga suratni ko'rsatib.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'downstairs' - PREDLOGSIZ.
⚠ 'who the young woman was' - o'zlashtirma
so'roq, so'z tartibi ODDIY.
⚠ 'softly' - RAVISh ('soft' + -ly).

points.en: [4 = B] Janice looked at it and gasped in amazement. The bride was wearing the same white dress as the young woman, and the flowers she was holding in the photograph were just like the ones Janice had.
points.uz: [4 = B] Janice unga qaradi va hayratdan nafasi bo'g'ildi. Kelin yosh ayolnikidek oq ko'ylak kiygan, suratdagi gullari esa Janice'dagi gullarga o'xshash edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 4-mashqning 4-javobi.
⚠ 'to gasp in amazement' (6-mashqda).
⚠ 'the same ... AS' - 22-betdagi qoida.
⚠ 'the ones' = 'the flowers' (takrorlamaslik
uchun).

points.en: "My grandmother died before I met you, didn't she?" James said. "Well, that's her in the photograph - and today is 15th April. It's her wedding anniversary."
points.uz: "Buvim men seni uchratishimdan oldin vafot etgan edi, shundaymi?" - dedi Jeyms. "Xo'sh, suratdagi - o'sha, va bugun 15-aprel. Bugun uning to'y yilligi".
points.noteUz:
⚠ "didn't she?" - QUESTION TAG (15-unit mavzusi).
⚠ 'an anniversary' = yillik (6-mashqda).
⚠ Bu - hikoyaning KALIT gapi: yosh ayol
Jeymsning BUVISI edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the story again and correct the statements.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyani qayta o'qing va gaplarni to'g'rilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  1  Janice was reading a book when the
     doorbell rang.
     → "She wasn't reading a book.
        She was watching TV."

  ⚠ IKKI QADAM:
     1) INKOR bilan rad etish
     2) TO'G'RI ma'lumot

  ⚠ 21-betdagi 20-mashq bilan bir xil
  g'oya, lekin bu yerda hamma gap
  PAST CONTINUOUS da.


TO'G'RI MA'LUMOTLAR:

  1  watching TV (reading a book emas)
  2  a LONG white dress (short emas)
  3  a BOUQUET OF FLOWERS (a clock emas)
  4  SITTING on the stairs (sleeping
     emas)


⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS INKORI:

  She WASN'T reading.
  They WEREN'T sitting.

  ⚠ 'was/were' + not + fe'l + -ing.
exercises.exampleEn: Janice was reading a book when the doorbell rang. - She wasn't reading a book. She was watching TV.
exercises.exampleUz: Eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringlaganda Janice kitob o'qiyotgan edi. - U kitob o'qimayotgan edi. U televizor ko'rayotgan edi.
modelAnswers: She wasn't reading a book. She was watching TV.
She wasn't wearing a short white dress. She was wearing a long white dress.
She wasn't holding a clock. She was holding a bouquet of flowers.
She wasn't sleeping. She was sitting on the stairs.
modelAnswersUz: U kitob o'qimayotgan edi. U televizor ko'rayotgan edi.
U kalta oq ko'ylak kiymagan edi. U uzun oq ko'ylak kiygan edi.
U soat ushlab turmagan edi. U guldasta ushlab turgan edi.
U uxlamayotgan edi. U zinapoyada o'tirgan edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA HIKOYaDA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  it SOUNDS like    - ... ga o'xshaydi
  the FRONT door    - oldingi eshik
  a local TAXI service - mahalliy taksi
                      xizmati
  a(n) BOUQUET of flowers - guldasta
  to CHANGE one's clothes - kiyim
                      almashtirmoq
  a clock TICKING   - chiqillayotgan
                      soat
  WEDDING day       - to'y kuni
  to GASP in amazement - hayratdan
                      nafasi bo'g'ilmoq
  wedding ANNIVERSARY - to'y yilligi


⚠ 'IT SOUNDS LIKE ...':

  = ovozi ... ga o'xshaydi.
  ⚠ 'to sound' - HIS fe'li, keyin SIFAT
  yoki 'like' + OT keladi:
     'It sounds interesting.' (sifat)
     'It sounds LIKE a clock.' (ot)

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'look like',
  'feel like', 'taste like', 'smell
  like'.


⚠ 'THE FRONT DOOR' va 'THE BACK DOOR':

  front door - ko'chaga chiqadigan eshik
  back door - orqa eshik (hovliga)


⚠ 'AN ANNIVERSARY':

  = yillik.
  ⚠ Lotincha 'annus' (yil) + 'versus'
  (aylanish).
  ⚠ Imlosi: IKKI 'n', IKKI 's'.

  ⚠ 'a birthday' - odam uchun;
  'an anniversary' - VOQEA uchun
  (to'y, tashkil topish).


⚠ 'A BOUQUET OF FLOWERS':

  ⚠ 'a bunch of flowers' ham to'g'ri va
  ko'proq ishlatiladi.
  ⚠ 'bouquet' - fransuzcha, /buˈkeɪ/.


⚠ 'TO CHANGE ONE'S CLOTHES':

  ⚠ 'one's' o'rniga egalik olmoshi:
  'change HIS clothes', 'change MY
  clothes'.
  ⚠ 'clothes' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli to'g'ri so'zning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
YAQIN MA'NOLI SO'ZLARNI FARQLASh.


⚠ 'ALONE' va 'LONELY':

  alone = yolg'iz (HOLAT: birov yo'q)
  lonely = yolg'izlikdan qiynalgan
     (HIS-TUYG'U)

  ⚠ 'I live alone but I'm not lonely.'
  = Yolg'iz yashayman, lekin
    zerikmayman.

  ⚠ Hikoyada: 'Janice was ALONE in the
  house' - shunchaki birov yo'q edi.


⚠ 'TO LAY' va 'TO LIE' - ENG QIYIN
JUFTLIK:

  to LIE (yotmoq) - O'TIMSIZ:
     lie - lay - lain; -ing: LYING
     'The book is LYING on the table.'

  to LAY (qo'ymoq) - O'TIMLI:
     lay - laid - laid; -ing: LAYING
     'She is LAYING the table.'

  ⚠ Chalkashlik sababi: 'lie' ning
  O'TGAN ZAMONI 'LAY' - ya'ni 'lay'
  fe'lining O'ZI bilan bir xil!

  ⚠ Hikoyada: 'her flowers were LYING
  on the doormat' - gullar O'ZI yotardi.


⚠ 'TO CHANGE' va 'TO CANCEL':

  to change = o'zgartirmoq
  to cancel = BEKOR qilmoq

  ⚠ 3-bandda 'raining heavily' sababli
  sayohat BEKOR qilingan - 'changed'
  emas.


⚠ 'TIME' va 'AN HOUR':

  time = vaqt (umuman); soat
     ko'rsatgan vaqt
  an hour = 60 daqiqa

  ⚠ 'Your watch shows the correct TIME.'
  ⚠ 'The film lasts two HOURS.'


⚠ 'KNOWN' va 'FAMILIAR':

  known = mashhur, tanilgan
     ('well known for' - 8-betda)
  familiar = tanish (ilgari ko'rgan)

  ⚠ 'She looks FAMILIAR to me.' =
  Uni qayerdadir ko'rganga o'xshayman.
  ⚠ Hikoyada: 'There was something
  FAMILIAR about the woman.'

items.textEn: 1  Tom was ___ in the shop when the robbers walked in.
items.uz: Do'konda birov yo'q edi - qaysi so'z?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'alone' = yolg'iz (HOLAT).
⚠ 'lonely' = yolg'izlikdan qiynalgan
(HIS-TUYG'U) - bu yerda mos kelmaydi.

⚠ Hikoyada ham: 'Janice was ALONE in the house'.

items.textEn: 2  All the boy's toys were ___ on the floor.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to LIE' (yotmoq) - o'timsiz, -ing: LYING.
⚠ 'to LAY' (qo'ymoq) - o'timli, to'ldiruvchi
talab qiladi.

⚠ Hikoyada: 'her flowers were LYING on the
doormat'.

items.textEn: 3  As it was raining heavily, they ___ their trip.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Yomon ob-havo sababli sayohat BEKOR qilinadi,
o'zgartirilmaydi.
⚠ Britaniyada 'cancelLED' (ikki 'l');
AQShda 'canceled'.

items.textEn: 4  Your watch does not show the correct ___ .
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to show the correct TIME' - turg'un ibora.
⚠ 'an hour' = 60 daqiqa (davomiylik).

⚠ Hikoyada: 'it showed the correct TIME'.

items.textEn: 5  "She looks very ___ to me," Josh said.
items.uz: Uni qayerdadir ko'rganga o'xshaydi - qaysi so'z?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'familiar' = tanish (ilgari ko'rgan).
⚠ 'known' = mashhur, tanilgan - boshqa ma'no.

⚠ Hikoyada: 'There was something FAMILIAR about
the woman'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct preposition, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: To'g'ri predlogni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PREDLOGLAR - HAMMASI HIKOYaDA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  AT night          - kechasi
  waiting FOR sb    - kimnidir kutmoq
  to call FOR a taxi - taksi chaqirmoq
  to tell sb ABOUT sth - kimgadir
                      nimadir haqida
                      aytmoq
  to sit ON the stairs - zinapoyada
                      o'tirmoq
  to turn ON the light - chiroq yoqmoq
  ON sb's wedding day - kimningdir to'y
                      kunida


⚠ 'AT NIGHT' - ISTISNO:

  IN the morning / afternoon / evening
  AT night

  ⚠ 'in the night' ham uchraydi, lekin
  boshqa ma'noda ('tun davomida').


⚠ 'TO WAIT FOR':

  ⚠ 'wait' PREDLOGSIZ ishlatilmaydi
  (odam yoki narsa bilan):
  'wait FOR the bus', 'wait FOR me'.


⚠ 'TO CALL FOR' va 'TO CALL':

  'to call sb' = kimgadir qo'ng'iroq
     qilmoq
  'to call FOR a taxi' = taksi
     ChAQIRMOQ

  ⚠ Ikki ibora BOShQA ma'noda.


⚠ 'TO TELL SB ABOUT STH':

  ⚠ 'tell' dan keyin ODAM predlogsiz:
  'tell ME about it'.
  ⚠ 'say' dan keyin esa 'to':
  'say something TO me'.


⚠ 'TO TURN ON' va 'TO TURN OFF':

  turn on = yoqmoq (chiroq, televizor)
  turn off = o'chirmoq

  ⚠ 'on' va 'off' - ZARRAChA, shuning
  uchun to'ldiruvchi o'rtada bo'lishi
  mumkin: 'turn IT on'.


⚠ 'ON SB'S WEDDING DAY':

  ⚠ Kun oldidan 'ON': on Monday,
  on 15th April, on my birthday.

items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to wait FOR sb/sth' - predlog ShART.
⚠ 'wait somebody' - XATO.

⚠ 'to call FOR a taxi' = taksi chaqirmoq.
⚠ 'to call sb' (predlogsiz) = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq -
BOShQA ma'no.

⚠ 'tell' dan keyin ODAM predlogsiz, MAVZU
oldidan 'about'.
⚠ 'say' bilan esa: 'say sth TO sb'.

⚠ 'ON the stairs' - yuza ustida.
⚠ Hikoyada: 'She sat down ON the stairs.'

⚠ 'to turn ON' = yoqmoq; 'to turn OFF' = o'chirmoq.
⚠ To'ldiruvchi o'rtada bo'lishi mumkin:
'turn IT on'.

⚠ KUN oldidan 'ON': on Monday, on 15th April,
on my birthday.

exercises.instructionEn: Use words/phrases from the list, and the pictures on p. 26, to help you retell the story.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'z va iboralardan hamda 26-betdagi rasmlardan foydalanib hikoyani qayta so'zlab bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaNI QAYTA SO'ZLASh.

  ⚠ Ro'yxatdagi so'zlar hikoyaning
  KETMA-KETLIGI bo'yicha berilgan -
  ularga qarab hikoyani boshdan-oxir
  aytish mumkin.


RO'YXAT (kitobdagi tartibda):

  watching TV, doorbell rang, young
  woman, long white dress, bouquet of
  flowers, called for a taxi, woman
  wasn't there, doormat, cancelled the
  call, puzzled, sat on the stairs,
  ghost, guest room, clock ticking, old
  photograph, wedding day, gasped in
  amazement, same white dress, 15th
  April, wedding anniversary


⚠ QAYSI ZAMONDA SO'ZLASh:

  Hikoya O'TGAN ZAMONDA:
     PAST CONTINUOUS - fon
     PAST SIMPLE - voqealar

  ⚠ 'Janice WAS WATCHING TV when the
  doorbell RANG.'


⚠ KETMA-KETLIK SO'ZLARI:

  First, ... - avval
  Then, ... - keyin
  After that, ... - shundan keyin
  Later, ... - keyinroq
  Finally, ... - nihoyat
  In the end, ... - oxir-oqibat

  ⚠ Bu so'zlar hikoyani BOG'LAYDI va
  tinglovchiga yo'l ko'rsatadi.

points.en: First, Janice was watching TV when the doorbell rang.
points.uz: Avval Janice televizor ko'rayotganda eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS (fon) + PAST SIMPLE (voqea).
⚠ Bu - butun hikoyaning grammatik qolipi.

points.en: She opened the door and saw a young woman in a long white dress with a bouquet of flowers.
points.uz: U eshikni ochdi va uzun oq ko'ylakdagi, qo'lida guldastali yosh ayolni ko'rdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Ikki fe'l bitta ega bilan: 'opened AND saw'.
⚠ 'in a dress' = ko'ylakda (kiyim uchun 'in').

points.en: Then Janice called for a taxi, but when she went back, the woman wasn't there and the flowers were lying on the doormat.
points.uz: Keyin Janice taksi chaqirdi, lekin qaytib kelganda ayol u yerda yo'q edi va gullar poyandozda yotardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to call FOR a taxi' - predlog 'for'.
⚠ 'were lying' - PAST CONTINUOUS.

points.en: She cancelled the call and sat on the stairs, puzzled.
points.uz: U chaqiruvni bekor qildi va hayron bo'lib zinapoyaga o'tirdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'cancelled' - Britaniyada ikki 'l'.
⚠ 'puzzled' - SIFAT ('hayron bo'lgan').

points.en: When James got home, she told him about the woman. He joked that she looked as if she had seen a ghost.
points.uz: Jeyms uyga kelganda, u ayol haqida aytib berdi. Jeyms hazillashib, u arvoh ko'rganga o'xshaydi, dedi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to tell sb ABOUT sth' - predlog 'about'.
⚠ 'as if' = ... ga o'xshab.

points.en: Later, James heard a clock ticking in the guest room and found an old photograph next to it.
points.uz: Keyinroq Jeyms mehmonxonada soat chiqillashini eshitdi va uning yonidan eski suratni topdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a clock ticking' - -ING shakli jarayonni
bildiradi.
⚠ 'next to' = yonida.

points.en: It was a wedding day photograph dated 15th April, 1910.
points.uz: Bu 1910-yil 15-aprel sanasi qo'yilgan to'y kuni surati edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'dated' = sana qo'yilgan.
⚠ Britaniya sanasi: kun → oy → yil.

points.en: Finally, he showed it to Janice, who gasped in amazement: the bride was the young woman, and today was her wedding anniversary.
points.uz: Nihoyat, u buni Janice'ga ko'rsatdi va u hayratdan nafasi bo'g'ildi: kelin o'sha yosh ayol edi va bugun uning to'y yilligi edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Finally' - xulosani boshlaydi.
⚠ 'to gasp in amazement' - turg'un ibora.
⚠ 'who' - nisbiy olmosh (12-unit mavzusi).

exercises.instructionEn: Adjectives describe nouns. Adverbs usually describe verbs or other adverbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlar otni tasvirlaydi. Ravishlar odatda fe'l yoki boshqa ravishni tasvirlaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI 'USE' QUTISI.

  'ADJECTIVES describe NOUNS.
   ADVERBS usually describe VERBS or
   other adverbs.'

  'She was holding a bouquet of PRETTY
   flowers.'  (sifat + ot)
  '"Excuse me," the young woman said
   SWEETLY.'  (fe'l + ravish)


⚠ ASOSIY FARQ:

  SIFAT → QANDAY? (ot haqida)
     'a pretty flower' - qanday gul?

  RAVISh → QANDAY QILIB? (fe'l haqida)
     'she said sweetly' - qanday aytdi?


⚠ RAVISh QANDAY YaSALADI:

  SIFAT + -LY:
     sweet → sweetly
     soft  → softly
     loud  → loudly
     heavy → heavily (undosh + y → -ily)
     terrible → terribly ('-le' → '-ly')


⚠ QOIDASIZ RAVIShLAR:

  good → WELL   (⚠ 'goodly' XATO)
  fast → fast   (o'zgarmaydi)
  hard → hard   (o'zgarmaydi)
  late → late   (o'zgarmaydi)
  early → early (o'zgarmaydi)

  ⚠ 'hardly' MAVJUD, lekin ma'nosi
  BOShQA: 'deyarli emas'.
     'He works HARD.' = qattiq ishlaydi
     'He HARDLY works.' = deyarli
        ishlamaydi

  ⚠ 'lately' ham boshqa ma'noda:
  'so'nggi paytlarda'.


⚠ -LY BILAN TUGAGAN SIFATLAR:

  friendly, lovely, lonely, silly,
  ugly, likely

  ⚠ Bular SIFAT, ravish EMAS!
  ⚠ Ulardan ravish yasash uchun
  'in a ... way' ishlatiladi:
  'in a friendly way'.


⚠ HIS FE'LLARIDAN KEYIN SIFAT:

  be, look, seem, sound, feel, taste,
  smell, become, get

  ⚠ Bulardan keyin SIFAT keladi,
  ravish EMAS:
     'She looks BEAUTIFUL.'
        ('beautifully' XATO)
     'It sounds GOOD.' ('well' XATO)
     'The food tastes DELICIOUS.'

  ⚠ Hikoyada: 'You LOOK as if ...',
  'It SOUNDS like ...'


⚠ HIKOYaDAGI RAVIShLAR:

  heavily  - qattiq (yomg'ir)
  sweetly  - shirin ohangda
  jokingly - hazillashib
  loudly   - baland ovozda
  softly   - ohista
  still    - hamon
  no longer - endi ... emas

points.en: Adjectives describe nouns.
points.uz: Sifatlar otni tasvirlaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ SIFAT savoli: QANDAY? (ot haqida).
⚠ 20-betda sifatlar TARTIBI o'rganilgan edi.

points.en: Adverbs usually describe verbs or other adverbs.
points.uz: Ravishlar odatda fe'l yoki boshqa ravishni tasvirlaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ RAVISh savoli: QANDAY QILIB? (fe'l haqida).
⚠ Ravish sifatni ham kuchaytirishi mumkin:
'very good', 'really nice'.

points.en: She was holding a bouquet of pretty flowers.
points.uz: U chiroyli gullar dastasini ushlab turardi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'pretty' - SIFAT, 'flowers' otini tasvirlaydi.
⚠ 'pretty' RAVISh ham bo'lishi mumkin:
'pretty good' = ancha yaxshi.

points.en: "Excuse me," the young woman said sweetly.
points.uz: "Kechirasiz", - dedi yosh ayol shirin ohangda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'sweetly' - RAVISh, 'said' fe'lini
tasvirlaydi.
⚠ 'sweet' + -LY.

points.en: good → well (irregular); fast, hard, late, early do not change.
points.uz: good → well (qoidasiz); fast, hard, late, early o'zgarmaydi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'goodly' - XATO.
⚠ 'hardly' MAVJUD, lekin 'deyarli emas'
ma'nosida - BUTUNLAY boshqa so'z.

points.en: After look, seem, sound, feel, taste and smell we use an adjective, not an adverb.
points.uz: look, seem, sound, feel, taste, smell fe'llaridan keyin ravish emas, SIFAT ishlatiladi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'She looks beautiful' ('beautifully' XATO).
⚠ 'It sounds good' ('well' XATO).

⚠ Hikoyada: 'It SOUNDS LIKE the clock ...'

patterns.exampleEn: She was watching TV when the doorbell rang.
patterns.exampleUz: U televizor ko'rayotganda eshik qo'ng'irog'i jiringladi.

patterns.exampleEn: She wasn't reading a book. She was watching TV.
patterns.exampleUz: U kitob o'qimayotgan edi. U televizor ko'rayotgan edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Noto'g'ri gapni to'g'rilash: avval INKOR,
keyin TO'G'RI ma'lumot.

patterns.exampleEn: It sounds like the clock my grandparents had.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'sound LIKE' + OT; 'sound' + SIFAT.
⚠ Xuddi shunday: look like, feel like,
taste like.

patterns.exampleEn: You look as if you've seen a ghost.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'as if' = ... ga o'xshab.
⚠ 'look' dan keyin SIFAT yoki 'as if' + GAP.

patterns.exampleEn: "Excuse me," the young woman said sweetly.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ RAVISh fe'lni tasvirlaydi: QANDAY QILIB aytdi?
⚠ Sifat + -LY.

groups.explanationUz: Bu so'zlar -LY olmaydi yoki ma'nosi o'zgaradi.
Bular RAVISh EMAS, SIFAT! Ravish yasash uchun 'in a ... way' ishlatiladi.
